notes.title: New demo update!!
notes.notes:
[p]Hey all,
[/p][p]We hope you’re as excited for launch day as we are! Just over three weeks until the 26th! Ahhhhhh!
[/p][p]Now, as you know today was our original launch date, which had to move due to a certain game *cough silksong cough* launching the day after, and we’re super grateful for the response we’ve had from you all. We’d like to thank you for your patience and understanding, so we’ve decided to treat you all to a big demo update as we couldn’t leave you with nothing today, could we! ♥️ This experience is now much closer to the 1.0 build, so you can get more of a taste in the run-up to launch. [/p][p][/p][p]Here are all the updates to go check out! [/p][p][/p][p]💎[b]Steam achievements![/b][/p][p]🍋 [b]4 new extra charm modifiers[/b] with powerful effects!
💰 Charms rebalanced[/p][p]🍒The Red button and energy charges have been completely overhauled[/p][p]📱Updated some phone abilities[/p][p]🍀New localisation [/p][p]🎮Optimised on Steam Deck [/p][p]🎰Twitch integration for Twitch partners or affiliated[/p][p]👀Updated [b]P L O T [/b][/p][p]🔔A bunch of quality of life features (such as the ability to resize the windowed game and more settings), polish, and ironing for a smoother experience![/p][p][/p][p]We hope you enjoy this new update and the few more weeks of the demo before the big day…
[/p][p]Talk soon and see you in the pit[/p][p]-Matteo & Lorenzo from Panik Arcade[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: PC gaming show- Release Window announced AAAAAAAA
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We’re back with more “pinch-me” news!

[h3]We just announced in PC Gaming Show that we will be launching CloverPit this summer![/h3]

[previewyoutube=8MEvTiH66X4;full][/previewyoutube]

This means you don’t have long to wait until this crazy game is yours to play 🎰 

We also are very excited to say that we currently have over 300,000 wishlists and half a million demo downloads 🤯 To see these kinds of numbers is so cool for us, we’re a tiny indie team and to see our work reach this many people is very very exciting! 

We can’t wait for you all to play the full game, make sure to stay tuned for more updates soon™️ and enjoy the demo in the meantime!

Speak soon!

Matteo and Lorenzo from Panik Arcade

notes.title: Demo update! 🎰
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

Again, we’d just like to say thank you so so much for playing our demo, we are currently #11 on the trending charts for ALL Steam releases and we’re reaching all new player peaks every 15 mins 🤯 The response has just been so wild, we could never have imagined this so thank you very much!!!

Based on the wonderful feedback from you guys, we have just pushed an update to the demo to improve your experience. Here are the main updates: 

[h3]Charms 🍀[/h3]
[list]
[*]The red button now emits a small sound when you have charms, so you’re reminded to use it! 
[*]Enchanted (Modded) charms when discarded now reward a higher amount of coins
[*]‘Raging Capitalist’ is now capped at 25% as per the text!
[/list]

[h3]Localization 🌍[/h3]
[list]
[*]For the French speakers, we have adjusted the translation of some of the charms to make more sense!
[*]Fixed a bug with initial language selection
[*]Fixed font to support accented characters on the slot machine
[/list]

[h3]Game 💻[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added steam cloud for the demo data
[*]Data is now encrypted and screenshots are more trustable!
[*]Vsync setting added!
[/list]


You can also sign up to playtest the full game by joining our previous game’s [url=https://discord.com/invite/NhnK2KU3BS]Discord[/url], as we’ve just added some channels dedicated to CloverPit!

Again, we hope you continue to enjoy our demo, and follow us on [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@panikarcadegames]Tiktok[/url] & [url=https://x.com/PanikArcade]Twitter[/url] for more on this crazy journey!! 

- Matteo and Lorenzo from Panik Arcade
